The engine defect is fixed and the acceptance criterion is met in both required forms: a detached worktree and a genuine fresh clone of origin/main each report zero problems and exit 0. The fix also removes the post-ship replay treadmill, demonstrated by commit 95d2028 publishing receipts whose own publication would previously have invalidated them.

THE TREADMILL TEST. This commit advanced HEAD past the head those two receipts were stamped at while touching only .saipen/, which the fingerprint excludes. Under HEAD equality both receipts would have been invalidated by their own publication; under the ancestor-tolerant rule they survived it.
